status: PROPOSED freeze. The values listed under decided_by_owner_2026-10-23 and decided_by_owner_2026-10-22 are owner decisions; every value listed under proposals is still a PROPOSAL. The owner freezes it: copy to pr6_hyd1_freeze.json (same folder), set "frozen": true, set owner_signature, commit. Nothing is built or scored before that commit; pr6_hyd1_build.py and pr6_hyd1_report.py refuse a file that is missing or not frozen. This file stays frozen: false.

Exact ids from the read-only outputs proteome_panel_ga.tsv (19 hit rows, 18 distinct proteins: E9QT94 hits two models) and negatives_panel_table.tsv of pre-check job 30321490, none of them called family by phmmer E <= 1e-5. 18 + 1 = 19 distinct ids. Hydrophobin-class panel hits that phmmer of the Kiss protein does not call family are left out of the extra-call count and the hard-negative rate, LISTED BY ID in panel_ignored. The report also prints the extra-call count and the hard-negative rate with those ids counted.

training_rule.note: DECIDED 2026-10-23 (Q2): reading total (the ecm33 code: 5 sequences in all outside clades together, in >= 2 clades), applied AFTER the independence rule. This is the WEAKER reading; per_clade (>= 2 outside clades each with >= 5 sequences) would leave only the Kiss unit buildable. per_clade counts are still printed in units.tsv.

independence_note: DECIDED 2026-10-23 (Q5): HEADLINE cluster30 (MMseqs2 30 percent identity, 50 percent coverage), second DESCRIPTIVE column none. A cluster: unit has one column (the held-out cluster is already removed).
min_u_note: DECIDED 2026-10-23 (Q6): min_u 3; the Kiss unit (n = 1) is never a rule unit. u = held-out members missed by every INDEPENDENT comparator (Pfam GA panel, relaxed panel, single-seed phmmer, the last skipped in the Kiss unit); the jackhmmer-from-seed ceiling is reported but never enters u. The custom model must recover ceil(u/2) of u.

alignment_check.note: min_columns 40 DECIDED 2026-10-23 (Q9; the query is 98 residues, 100 occupied columns cannot be reached); occupancy 0.5 and min_median_coverage 0.6 are still PROPOSALS. No cysteine-column check as a stop condition; the cysteine pattern of the 30 members is a descriptive note only.

evalue_db_size_note: DECIDED 2026-10-23 (Q10): -Z 70198728 on the seed searches = the UniRef50 2025_03 sequence count of the round 2 provenance (uniprot_fasta_sequences), so E <= 1e-5 means what it meant in the search that found the members

comparators.pfam_ga: the eight hydrophobin-class Pfam models of the panel (PF01185 PF06766 PF22354 PF28987 PF29802 PF29785 PF29465 PF12296), hmmsearch --cut_ga; INDEPENDENT
comparators.relaxed_panel: data/sorting_hat/hydrophobin_relaxed.hmm (frozen 2.6-bit full-sequence cutoff, --nobias --cut_ga; committed 2026-10); INDEPENDENT; the 8-cysteine condition of the module is not applied (reported as a second descriptive column only if the owner asks)
comparators.phmmer_seed: phmmer -Z <evalue_db_size> -E 1e-5 of the single Kiss protein A0ACE4KFX7 over the held-out members; INDEPENDENT of the training alignment; not run in the Kiss unit (the seed is the held-out member)
comparators.jackhmmer_seed_ceiling: jackhmmer -N 3 --incE 1e-5 from the single Kiss protein, same -Z; CEILING: it found the members, so it recovers them by construction; reported, never in u
comparators._note: DECIDED 2026-10-23 (Q6): the alignment-independent set; jackhmmer from the single protein only as a ceiling outside u

heldout_truth.within_member_set: clade units and cluster units of the drift-supported members: search-defined and circular, every cell descriptive
